children: Round-up of South Korean financial markets:

** South Korean shares rebounded more than 3% on Wednesday and posted their biggest daily jump in 6 weeks, as strong exports and upbeat earnings forecasts improved investor sentiment around AI stocks.
closed up 182.92 points, or 3.29%, at 5,735.66, rebounding from Tuesday's close at a 6-month low and marking the biggest daily percentage rise since September 7.
** South Korea's exports more than doubled in the first 20 days of this month from a year earlier, led by record chip sales driven by global AI investment, customs data showed.

surged in after-hours trading on Tuesday after the server maker forecast quarterly revenue and profit margin well above Wall Street estimates on relentless AI data centre demand. The upbeat outlook also lifted other AI-related stocks.
** Among other index heavyweights, battery maker LG Energy Solution
surged 30%, rebounding from a slump in its market debut on Tuesday.
** Of the total 915 traded issues, 371 shares advanced, while 491 declined.
** Foreigners were net buyers of shares worth 660.0 billion won ($498.38 million).
** The won was quoted at 1,325.2 per dollar on the onshore settlement platform
, 0.06% higher than its previous close at 1,326.0.
** In money and debt markets, December futures on three-year treasury bonds (KTBc1) gained 0.03 point to 103.09.
